title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech, Promoting the Integration of Theory and Practice, and Strengthening the Cultivation of Legal Talents
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech, Promoting the Integration of Theory with Practice, and Strengthening the Training of Legal Talent

Fa Fa [2017] No. 26

Comprehensive law-based governance requires a large number of high-quality legal professionals. People's courts possess rich judicial resources and bear significant responsibility in the training of legal talent. In order to earnestly implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech during his inspection of China University of Political Science and Law, to fully leverage the judicial resource advantages of people's courts, and to actively serve and advance the work of training legal talent, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

1. Deeply Study and Understand the Spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech, and Fully Recognize the Important Responsibility People's Courts Bear in the Training of Legal Talent

General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech delivered during his inspection of China University of Political Science and Law, from the strategic and overall perspective of realizing the "Two Centenary" goals and the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, profoundly expounds the significant role, historical significance, and goals and requirements of comprehensive law-based governance. It systematically elaborates the important significance of training legal talent in comprehensive law-based governance, enriching and developing Marxist legal thought and the socialist rule of law theory with Chinese characteristics. The speech is highly ideological, guiding, and targeted, and has important and far-reaching guiding significance for strengthening the training of legal talent, promoting justice for the people and impartial justice, and comprehensively advancing law-based governance.

People's courts at all levels must regard the study and implementation of the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech during his inspection of China University of Political Science and Law as a major political task, deeply study and understand the spirit of the speech, accurately grasp its essence and main points, accurately grasp the major tasks deployed by the speech, and combine the actual circumstances of the courts to implement the work. The study and implementation of the important expositions in the speech concerning the training of legal talent should be highlighted as a key focus. It is necessary to fully recognize the importance and necessity of strengthening exchanges and cooperation between people's courts, law schools, and legal research institutions, and promoting the organic integration of legal education, legal research, and judicial practice. It is necessary to fully recognize the important driving role of strengthening the training of legal talent for the standardization, specialization, and professionalization of people's court personnel. It is necessary to fully recognize the resource advantages and important responsibilities of people's courts in the training of legal talent, actively leverage the subjective initiative of people's courts, and enhance the ideological consciousness and action consciousness of advancing the training of legal talent.

2. Based on the Actual Work of People's Courts, Actively Promote Innovation in Legal Theory and the Training of High-Quality Judicial Personnel

(1) Adhere to Guiding the Court Team with Scientific Theory, and Strengthen Socialist Rule of Law Theory Education and Research. People's courts at all levels must fully recognize the extreme importance of correct theoretical guidance for the work of people's courts, solidly advance the normalization and institutionalization of the "Two Studies, One Action" learning and education campaign, generally establish specialized courses for studying the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's series of important speeches in various training programs, guide court cadres to strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," establish the "Four Confidences," and strive to become firm believers, active disseminators, and exemplary practitioners of Marxist legal thought and the socialist rule of law theory with Chinese characteristics. Earnestly implement the requirements of adhering to the combination of rule of law and rule of virtue, strengthen education on core socialist values, the fine traditions of people's judicature, and the professional ethics of judges, and lay a solid ideological and moral foundation for impartial and honest exercise of judicial power. Give full play to the roles of the Supreme People's Court Research Center for Socialist Rule of Law Theory with Chinese Characteristics, the China Institute of Applied Jurisprudence, and the China Judicial Research Society. Deeply explore the excellent traditional Chinese judicial culture, scientifically summarize the practical experience of handling cases and judicial reform, deepen theoretical research on major issues of rule of law construction, and promote theoretical innovation closely linked to judicial practice. Make full use of various court media, especially new media, at all levels to strengthen the publicity, education, and dissemination of the socialist rule of law theory. The People's Court Press should strengthen the planning and selection of publications on rule of law theory, and strive to produce high-quality works reflecting the innovative achievements of the socialist rule of law theory with Chinese characteristics.

(2) Fully Tap the Resources of Judicial Big Data, and Promote Positive Interaction between Trial Practice and Legal Education and Research. Give full play to the roles of the China Institute of Judicial Big Data Research, the Judicial Case Research Institute, and China Judgments Online. Adhere to a problem-oriented and demand-oriented approach, integrate various data resources from courts across the country, use information technologies such as cloud computing and artificial intelligence to deeply analyze and mine judicial big data, generate analysis reports on trial trends and characteristics of similar cases, summarize and refine adjudication rules for similar cases, intelligently push relevant legal provisions and cases, serve judges in handling cases, and improve judicial capacity and standards. Promote the open sharing of judicial research resources, data, and achievements, and provide rich practical experience and resource materials for legal education and theoretical research. Build and make good use of the relevant research cooperation platforms between the Supreme People's Court and law schools. Encourage Higher People's Courts, based on the needs of trial practice, to establish specialized research bases for judicial practice in law schools or research institutions where conditions permit.

(3) Effectively Leverage the Platform Role of the National Judges College, and Strive to Improve the Quality of Judicial Personnel Training. Vigorously promote the construction of the National Judges College and local judge training institutions at all levels, adhere to combining theory with practice, and cultivate high-quality judicial personnel with both integrity and ability. Actively adapt to the requirements of judicial reform, improve the judge training curriculum system and textbook system, and deepen the reform of training content and methods. Correctly handle the relationship between theoretical training and practical teaching, increase the proportion of judge teaching, case teaching, and on-site teaching, encourage and guide court leading cadres, trial business experts, and outstanding senior judges to actively participate in training and teaching, bring the valuable practical experience and vivid cases of judicial practice into the judge training classroom, and enhance the pertinence and effectiveness of training. Expand the depth and breadth of the application of information technology in judge training, fully utilize the China Judge Training Network and local judge training networks, gather high-quality educational resources from the court system and law schools, and meet the immediate learning needs of court cadres. Give full play to the important role of the National Judges College as an international judicial exchange platform, carry out judicial training cooperation, hold special judicial seminars, and promote international cooperation and exchange of judicial talent.

(4) Utilize the High-Quality Educational Resources of Law Schools to Support the Education and Training Work of People's Courts. People's courts at all levels may, based on the needs of trial practice and team building, invite experts and scholars from law schools to give academic lectures for court cadres, participate in judge training and teaching, and help cadres understand cutting-edge theories and update legal knowledge. The Supreme People's Court shall continue to jointly cultivate applied doctoral and master's law students with relevant law schools. Where conditions permit, courts may entrust law schools to organize special training courses, open commissioned postgraduate degree education classes, and enhance the legal literacy and educational level of cadres. Courts in ethnic minority areas should strengthen cooperation with relevant ethnic universities, solidly advance the training of bilingual judges for ethnic minorities, actively coordinate with qualified ethnic universities to offer bilingual law programs, and train bilingual judge reserve personnel oriented towards ethnic minority area courts.

3. Leverage the Judicial Resource Advantages of People's Courts to Provide Strong Support for Legal Education and Legal Research Work

(1) Select and Dispatch Outstanding Judges to Participate in Legal Education and Research Work. People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the deployment and requirements of the Organization Department and the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Party Committee, regularly select and dispatch a certain number of qualified judges or other business backbones to law schools or legal research institutions for secondment, serve as practical teachers (researchers), offer practical judicial teaching courses, undertake teaching and research tasks, participate in the compilation of legal textbooks, and bring the practical experience and vivid cases of judicial trials of people's courts into the lecturing hall of legal education. Where law schools select and appoint judges as part-time teachers, and invite judges to participate in project research, textbook compilation, and the formulation of talent training plans, the relevant courts shall actively support and recommend excellent candidates.

(2) Select and Appoint Legal Experts and Scholars to Undertake Secondment and Training in Courts. People's courts at all levels shall establish a seconding scholar system, and in accordance with the deployment and requirements of the Organization Department and the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Party Committee, select and appoint a certain number of legal experts and scholars each year to undertake secondment in courts. The relevant courts shall arrange for the seconded expert scholars to hold corresponding positions, participate in professional judge meetings as needed, attend judicial committee meetings as non-voting participants, participate in case handling, judicial policy research, and other work, and help the expert scholars to comprehensively and deeply understand judicial trial practice.

(3) Actively Promote the Legal Research Scholar System. Summarize and promote the experience of some courts in receiving legal research scholars. Implement the legal research scholar system in Higher People's Courts and qualified Intermediate and Primary People's Courts, and expand the channels for combining legal theory with judicial practice. Courts receiving research scholars shall regularly publish relevant research topics and the conditions for receiving research scholars. Upon individual application and consent from their employing unit, arrange for legal expert scholars to undertake research project tasks. The court shall arrange for research scholars to participate in relevant work or research activities, provide necessary judicial cases and related materials, provide favorable conditions for research scholars to complete their research work, and actively assist research scholars in achieving the transformation of their research results.

(4) Generally Implement the Legal Intern System. Local courts at all levels shall earnestly implement the Supreme People's Court's "Provisions on Establishing a Legal Intern System," and regard receiving law students for internships in courts as an important task for strengthening judicial practice teaching and promoting the training of legal talent. Courts shall adhere to the principle of accepting interns from nearby locations, establish long-term cooperative relationships with local law schools, and have the relevant law schools organize uniformly and recommend outstanding students, regularly receiving law students for internships in courts. Interns shall be arranged to serve as intern judge assistants or intern clerks, participate in litigation services, case recording, drafting legal documents, mediation, service of process, property preservation, and other trial support work, to meet the internship students' need for a comprehensive understanding of trial work. Courts in relevant regions shall further do a good job in receiving Hong Kong legal interns for exchange internships in mainland courts.

(5) Support Law Schools in Establishing Practical Teaching Bases in Courts. People's courts at all levels shall actively support law schools in establishing practical teaching bases in courts. Based on the teaching needs of law schools, receive law students to observe court hearings, arrange for senior judges to guide students in mock trials, and provide law schools with typical cases and hearing videos for teaching purposes. Law school teachers and students may be invited to participate in court open days, rule of law publicity and education activities, observe court hearings, and visit court history museums, museums, revolutionary traditional education bases, etc., to support law schools in carrying out education on the socialist rule of law concept and the fine traditions of people's judicature. Where expert scholars from law schools apply to consult relevant case files, legal documents, and judicial statistics data for teaching and research needs, within the scope permitted by laws, regulations, and relevant systems, the court acting as their practical teaching base shall permit the inspection and provide convenient conditions.

(6) Organize Law School Teachers and Students to Participate in Legal Volunteer Activities. People's courts at all levels may, through consultation with relevant law schools, based on the needs of legal talent training and court trial work, set up legal volunteer positions in court litigation service centers as a platform for law school teachers and students to understand national conditions and serve the public. Legal volunteers shall mainly be composed of young teachers, or current graduate or undergraduate students, from law schools. They shall use time outside of work or study to participate in legal consultation, case persuasion and petition visits, litigation guidance, and other work in court litigation service centers, enhancing the understanding and recognition of law school teachers and students regarding the judicial needs of the people and the judicial practice of people's courts.

4. Strengthen Organizational Leadership and Communication and Coordination, and Earnestly Do a Good Job in the Exchange and Cooperation Work Between People's Courts, Law Schools, and Legal Research Institutions

(1) Raise Ideological Awareness and Strengthen Organizational Leadership. The training of legal talent is an important component of comprehensive law-based governance. Innovating the mechanism for training legal talent is a clear requirement put forward by the Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. Earnestly studying and implementing the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech during his inspection of China University of Political Science and Law, and leveraging the judicial resource advantages of people's courts to advance the training of legal talent, is a political responsibility that people's courts at all levels cannot shirk. People's courts at all levels must raise ideological awareness and political standing, strengthen overall awareness and strategic thinking, incorporate the advancement of legal talent training into the overall layout of court work, strengthen unified leadership and overall planning and coordination, actively carry out exchanges and cooperation with law schools and research institutions based on the actual needs of the work. Relevant court departments must unify ideological understanding, seriously research and plan, take the initiative to act, and the political work departments must do a good job in overall planning and coordination to ensure that all work measures are implemented and take effect.

(2) Improve Working Mechanisms and Carefully Organize Implementation. People's courts at all levels shall, based on the principles of proximity, convenience, voluntary consultation, and mutually beneficial cooperation, strengthen contact and communication with relevant law schools, establish a cooperation and consultation mechanism, deeply understand the specific needs of law schools for the support of legal education and legal research by people's courts, sign cooperation agreements tailored to local conditions, clarify the content and methods of cooperation, and earnestly implement them. The Supreme People's Court will establish cooperative relations with some key law schools and actively support the "Double First-Class" construction of relevant law schools. Higher People's Courts at all levels shall strengthen the organization and guidance of courts within their jurisdiction, establish a comprehensive coordination mechanism, scientifically plan the cooperation layout between courts within their jurisdiction and law schools, and balancedly allocate court practical teaching resources and high-quality educational resources from law schools. Relevant courts shall, together with law schools and research institutions, establish and improve the management and assessment system for personnel participating in exchanges and cooperation, clarify disciplinary requirements, management methods, and assessment methods, and resolutely prevent situations that affect judicial fairness.

(3) Improve Incentive Measures and Provide Support and Guarantee. For judges who are seconded to law schools or research institutions under organizational arrangements to serve as practical teachers (researchers), the employing court shall retain their judge status, keep their basic salary and welfare benefits unchanged, and continuously calculate their tenure as trial judges. For judges who, with organizational approval, support legal education through part-time teaching, participating in textbook compilation, serving as graduate supervisors, etc., their annual performance evaluation shall be fully considered and their workload reasonably converted. For legal expert scholars seconded to courts and law students interning in courts, the relevant courts shall provide necessary working and living conditions within the scope permitted by policies. Where conditions permit, courts may provide appropriate work allowances and transportation subsidies for seconded expert scholars. For outstanding seconded judges, seconded expert scholars, legal research scholars, legal interns, and legal volunteers, commendation may be made in an appropriate manner.

September 18, 2017
